deadline.value: The Fall PhD deadline is December 15; the Spring PhD intake has its own earlier deadline.
deadline.quote: Chemistry (MS, PhD) Degree Term Deadline PhD Fall December 15

supervisor.value: A faculty adviser is chosen during the first year, so admission does not need a named adviser.
supervisor.quote: Choice of a research adviser is usually completed by the end of the first semester

funding.value: Assistantships are listed at $30,470 for 2025-26 with tuition waived, but the page does not say how many admitted PhD students receive one.

entry_route.value: The chemistry pages do not say whether a master's degree is needed before the PhD.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

notes: The chemistry.wfu.edu/graduate/ page returned 502; the programs-of-study page loaded and is used here. Subject GRE is not mentioned on any fetched page.
